description: This file declares functions and includes necessary headers for managing harvesting status of Neighbor Access Points (AP) on demand within the harvester module. It defines API functions to set and get the harvesting status related to neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: SetNAPOnDemandHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for Neighbor AP on demand scans. Returns 0 on success, 1 on failure.

methods.name: GetNAPOnDemandHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status for Neighboring AP on demand scans, returning true if enabled, false if disabled.
